mapper.sql: m.mission_id, m.mission_category, m.mission_type, m.title, m.description, m.action_type, m.display_order, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mission_completion umc WHERE umc.user_id = #{userId} AND umc.mission_id = m.mission_id AND ( m.mission_category = 'ONE_TIME' OR umc.completion_date = CURDATE() ) ) AS completed
mapper.select:
WITH mission_candidates AS ( SELECT m.mission_id, 1 AS section_order, 0 AS subsection_order, 0 AS priority_order, m.display_order, m.mission_id AS sort_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY m.display_order, m.mission_id ) AS candidate_no FROM mission m WHERE m.is_active = TRUE AND m.mission_category = 'DAILY' AND m.mission_type IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT m.mission_id, 2 AS section_order, CASE m.mission_type WHEN 'SAFE' THEN 1 WHEN 'AGGRESSIVE' THEN 2 END AS subsection_order, 0 AS priority_order, m.display_order, m.mission_id AS sort_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY m.mission_type ORDER BY m.display_order, m.mission_id ) AS candidate_no FROM mission m WHERE m.is_active = TRUE AND m.mission_category = 'RECOMMENDED' AND m.mission_type IN ('SAFE', 'AGGRESSIVE')
UNION ALL
SELECT m.mission_id, 3 AS section_order, 0 AS subsection_order, 0 AS priority_order, m.display_order, m.mission_id AS sort_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY m.display_order, m.mission_id ) AS candidate_no FROM mission m WHERE m.is_active = TRUE AND m.mission_category = 'ONE_TIME'
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_mission_completion umc WHERE umc.user_id = #{userId} AND umc.mission_id = m.mission_id )
UNION ALL
SELECT m.mission_id, 4 AS section_order, 0 AS subsection_order, m.event_priority AS priority_order, m.display_order, m.mission_id AS sort_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY m.event_priority, m.display_order, m.mission_id ) AS candidate_no FROM mission m LEFT JOIN soldier_profile sp ON sp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.is_active = TRUE AND m.mission_category = 'EVENT' AND ( (m.trigger_type = 'DAYS_TO_DISCHARGE' AND DATEDIFF(sp.discharge_date, CURDATE()) = m.trigger_value) OR (m.trigger_type = 'LEAVE_SCHEDULED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM leave_mode lm WHERE lm.user_id = #{userId} AND lm.start_date = CURDATE() )) OR (m.trigger_type = 'PAYDAY' AND DAY(CURDATE()) = m.trigger_value) ) ) SELECT
FROM mission_candidates mc INNER JOIN mission m ON m.mission_id = mc.mission_id WHERE (mc.section_order = 1 AND mc.candidate_no <= 2) OR (mc.section_order > 1 AND mc.candidate_no = 1) ORDER BY mc.section_order, mc.subsection_order, mc.priority_order, mc.display_order, mc.sort_id

SELECT m.mission_id, m.mission_category, m.mission_type, m.title, m.description, m.action_type, m.display_order, FALSE AS completed FROM mission m WHERE m.mission_id = #{missionId} AND m.is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_badge (user_id) VALUES (#{userId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id)
INSERT INTO investment_badge ( user_id, safe_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE safe_count = safe_count + 1
INSERT INTO investment_badge ( user_id, aggressive_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE aggressive_count = aggressive_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT badge_id, mission_type, required_completion_count, grade FROM badge WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY mission_type, required_completion_count
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO user_badge ( user_id, badge_id ) VALUES
( #{userId}, #{badgeId} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id)
mapper.update:
UPDATE investment_badge
safe_grade = #{grade},
aggressive_grade = #{grade},
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge_monthly_result ( member_id, result_month, mission_completion_count ) SELECT cm.member_id, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), 1 FROM challenge_member cm WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mission_completion_count = mission_completion_count + 1

INSERT INTO challenge_member_summary ( member_id, total_mission_count ) SELECT cm.member_id, 1 FROM challenge_member cm WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_mission_count = total_mission_count + 1
